content.title: Two-week U.S.-Iran ceasefire agreed on; Ceasefire impact on markets | 9 News Australia
content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more Iran has agreed to a two-week ceasefire if attacks against the country are halted. Donald Trump backed down on a threat to bomb the country's infrastructure and "end civilisation in Iran".
